title: The Vat of Death
front_description: The wild battle in the Geonosian droid factory continues, both Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala fighting for their lives. The young Senator struggles to escape the vat that imprisons her before she's alive by molten metal poured from above. At the very last moment, Artoo finds the computer port controlling the vats and programs Padmé's to dump her safely onto a walkway.
back_description: R2-D2 comes to the rescue at Padmé scrambles for her life.
